evals.prompt: /kickoff plans/2026-09-27-team-billing-plan.md claude/team-billing except the admin dashboard
expectations: creates a WL1 worklog (worklog tool op start, or plans/*-worklog.md) before any code
uses a phase branch and one commit per step with a green gate before each done
never pushes or opens a PR
passes an explicit model on every Agent call, respecting the session's model allow-list if one is set

evals.prompt: /kickoff plans/x.md  (plan step A2 cannot be done as written: the table it migrates no longer exists)
expectations: stops with stop class 4 (plan proven wrong) or records a Ruling, does not invent a different migration silently

evals.prompt: near-miss: fix the typo in the onboarding title
expectations: kickoff is not used (it is user-invoked only)
reads the active worklog instead of creating one
checks doing steps against git (commits, worktree status) before acting
does not redo a committed step or discard uncommitted work
logs one 'Resumed after an interruption' line, then continues the step loop
